_meta.description: The assistant's tool catalog. The AI answers with {say, tool, args}; tool is 'none' or one of these names. 'prompt' is the exact text shown to the model; 'prompt_layout' groups tools into prompt lines (joined with ' | ', lines joined with newline) and replaces {{tools}} in prompts/system.md.

when.description: add_task: time phrase, e.g. '5 pm', 'in 10 minutes', 'tomorrow 9am' or ''

text.description: add_note: note text; clipboard: target language; screen: what to type

query.description: find_notes / web_search: the query; screen: the on-screen thing

action.description: clipboard: explain|summarize|translate; meeting_notes: start|stop|bookmark; work_context: park|resume; screen: click|type|read|task

tools.name: desktop
tools.description: Control the device with one short English command from the command grammar.
tools.prompt: desktop {command}: control the PC with a short English command, e.g. "open spotify", "switch to chrome", "play <exactly what the user asked for> on youtube", "volume up", "next tab", "scroll down", "pause", "search for <query>", any keyboard shortcut like "press windows h", "press control shift t", "press alt f4", or Windows actions like "open voice typing", "open clipboard history", "open task manager"

tools.name: add_task
tools.prompt: add_task {title, when}: task/reminder; when like "5 pm", "in 10 minutes", "tomorrow 9am" or ""

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Store a lasting fact about the user (third person).
tools.prompt: remember {fact}: lasting fact about the user, third person

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the web for current information.

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Read the browser tab the user is looking at.
tools.prompt: read_page {}: the browser tab the user is looking at

tools.name: clipboard
tools.description: Explain, summarise or translate the clipboard.

tools.name: meeting_notes
tools.description: Start/stop meeting notes or bookmark a moment.

tools.name: work_context
tools.description: Park or resume a work context.

tools.name: open_panel
tools.description: Open a panel of the app.

tools.name: screen
tools.description: Act on what is on screen (click, type, read, or a multi-step task).
tools.prompt: screen {action: click|type|read|task, text: what to type, query: the on-screen thing, e.g. "second video", "search box", "Subscribe button", goal: for task = a multi-step goal on the current screen}
